title: Only highlights notifications with two categories at the same time
goal: Use a compound selector without spaces to match elements with both characteristics.
summary: Some announcements have the notice category, and some content have the urgent category. Only elements that have both require a warning color.
tasks: Set the text of elements with both classes notice and urgent to #7c460e.
Text with notice or urgent alone will continue to use the default color of the page.

example.note: The two class selectors are directly connected and match the same element. Adding spaces in between will match descendants.

hint: Write out two class names respectively, and then combine them into a selector without spaces.
